question_zh: 圖書館平日的開放時間是什麼？
answer_zh: 示範圖書館於週一至週五 08:30 至 21:00 開放。請注意這是虛構示範資料。
question_en: What are the weekday opening hours?
answer_en: The demo library is open Monday through Friday from 8:30 AM to 9:00 PM. This is fictional demonstration data.

question_zh: 圖書館週末的開放時間是什麼？
answer_zh: 示範圖書館於週六 09:00 至 17:00 開放，週日不開放。請注意這是虛構示範資料。
question_en: What are the weekend opening hours?
answer_en: The demo library is open Saturday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM and closed on Sunday. This is fictional demonstration data.

answer_zh: 請使用校園卡在自助借書機或服務台辦理借閱。請注意這是虛構示範資料。
question_en: How do I borrow an item?
answer_en: Use your campus card at the self-checkout machine or service desk to borrow an item. This is fictional demonstration data.

question_zh: 一次最多可以借幾本書？
answer_zh: 示範規則是每位讀者最多可借閱 10 本一般圖書。請注意這是虛構示範資料。
question_en: How many books can I borrow at once?
answer_en: Under the demo rules each reader may borrow up to 10 regular books. This is fictional demonstration data.

answer_zh: 示範規則是一般圖書借期為 21 天。請注意這是虛構示範資料。
question_en: How long is the loan period for regular books?
answer_en: Under the demo rules regular books have a 21-day loan period. This is fictional demonstration data.

question_zh: 可以續借已借閱的書嗎？
answer_zh: 若該書沒有其他讀者預約，示範規則允許續借一次。請注意這是虛構示範資料。
question_en: Can I renew a borrowed book?
answer_en: Under the demo rules you may renew an item once if no other reader has reserved it. This is fictional demonstration data.

answer_zh: 示範規則是逾期期間將暫停新的借閱權限，直到歸還館藏。請注意這是虛構示範資料。
question_en: What happens if an item is overdue?
answer_en: Under the demo rules new borrowing is paused until the item is returned. This is fictional demonstration data.

question_zh: 如何預約已被借走的書？
answer_zh: 請在示範館藏系統搜尋書名後，選擇預約按鈕。請注意這是虛構示範資料。
question_en: How do I reserve a checked-out book?
answer_en: In the demo catalog, search for the title and select the reserve button. This is fictional demonstration data.

answer_zh: 示範圖書館在二樓提供 20 台公共電腦，使用校園帳號登入。請注意這是虛構示範資料。
answer_en: The demo library provides 20 public computers on the second floor; sign in with a campus account. This is fictional demonstration data.

answer_zh: 示範規則是只能在一樓休息區飲用有蓋飲料，不可在閱覽區用餐。請注意這是虛構示範資料。
question_en: Can I eat or drink in the library?
answer_en: Under the demo rules, covered drinks are allowed only in the first-floor lounge and food is not allowed in reading areas. This is fictional demonstration data.

answer_zh: 請先通知服務台暫停借閱權限，再依示範校園流程申請補發。請注意這是虛構示範資料。
question_en: What should I do if I lose my campus card?
answer_en: First notify the service desk to pause borrowing, then apply for a replacement through the demo campus process. This is fictional demonstration data.

question_zh: 可以借閱期刊或參考書嗎？
answer_zh: 示範規則是期刊與參考書僅限館內閱覽，不提供外借。請注意這是虛構示範資料。
question_en: Can I borrow journals or reference books?
answer_en: Under the demo rules journals and reference books are for in-library use only. This is fictional demonstration data.
